title: 交易心理 | 扛单的时候，你的大脑在骗你
subTitle:
浮亏50%的人在看什么？在看「历史最高价」，心里念叨：回到我的成本，
我就走。注意，这个想法里全是执念，没有逻辑。市场不知道你的成本价，
它只认当下的供需。

扛起单之后，你会自动收集利好、屏蔽利空，这叫确认偏误。你会觉得
「这次不一样」，这五个字，历史上烧掉的钱比任何黑客都多。

解药其实很简单，但很难做到：开仓前就写好「什么情况下这笔单的逻辑
失效」，到点执行，不看心情。把决策从持有中剥离出来，你才能看清
盘面在说什么，而不是你想听什么。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#交易心理 #扛单 #BTC #ETH

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Lying to You When You Refuse to Let Go of a Position
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% on a position focus on? The “all-time high,” thinking, “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Pay attention: this thought is all attachment, no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to current supply and demand.

Once you stubbornly hold onto a position, you start automatically collecting bullish signals and blocking out bearish ones. This is called confirmation bias. You’ll think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have cost more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to do: before entering a trade, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
fails,” then follow through when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate decision-making from holding a position, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

They’re all ways for new projects to raise funds by selling tokens, so why are there so many different terms?
The key difference is who runs the sale: with an ICO, the project sells the tokens itself; an IEO is organized by an exchange; an IDO takes place on-chain.
An IEO (Initial Exchange Offering) is a token sale conducted through an exchange’s launch platform, with the exchange responsible for vetting the project and handling the sale.
